notes.pending:
以下阈值本体无专家依据，暂按建议值填写，需业务确认后定稿：
IS03 销售额与出货量量价背离：|R03| ≥ 10 个百分点（建议值·待业务确认）；分级 |R03| ≥ 20 个百分点 高；10～20 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS04 超期订未发积压：S05 > 0 且 S08 ≥ 0.2（建议值·待业务确认）；分级 S08 ≥ 0.5 高；0.2～0.5 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS05 在手订单不足以覆盖剩余目标：剩余目标 > 0 且 C09 < 1（金额、电量分别判断）；分级 C09 < 0.5 高；0.5～1 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS06 订单履约率偏低：O03 < 0.8（建议值·待业务确认）；分级 O03 < 0.6 高；0.6～0.8 中（建议值·待业务确认）
IS08 订单取消／变更冲减：O04 > 0；分级 O04 ÷ O01 ≥ 0.05 高；其余 中（建议值·待业务确认）
DQ03 达成率与基础指标不一致：|R01 − B02 ÷ B01| > 0.01 或 |R02 − B04 ÷ B03| > 0.01（建议值·待业务确认）；分级 中
DQ04 订未发结构不闭合：S04 > 0 且 |S05 + S07 − S04| ÷ S04 > 0.05（建议值·待业务确认）；分级 中
RC06 产品结构或单价偏离目标：|R09 − R10| ÷ R10 ≥ 0.1（建议值·待业务确认）
notes.dataGaps: S09 计划外发货在计划缺失或行匹配不唯一时返回空值；LE19 / LE20 字段空值率字典未统计；商机部分（OR*）的输入缺失与部分合计以 1117 调用SQL明细为准。

V4（2026-11-17）：商机部分同步亿纬锂能本体文件_1117——商机问题改为 IS11 商机预测覆盖不足、IS12 客户预测不足、IS13 商机推进超期，影响签单，用 1117 的 R01 / R08 / R12～R17 调用SQL（OR01、OR08、OR12～OR17）在本卡片内判定；同步 1117 根因 RC13～RC20 与行动建议 AC14～AC22；删除 IS02、IS07、IS09、IS10、DQ06、RC07、AC07 及指标 C01～C08、C10、R04～R07；RC01、RC02 改按 OR01、OR13 / OR15 / OR17 判定。V3 保持不变。

B01.name: 目标销售额
B01.definition: 所选年度销售目标金额汇总（人民币元 ÷ 10^8）。
B01.rule: 目标先按商机 ID＋年度去重取最新版本再汇总（BR-Q03）；销售额达成率与预计达成率的分母。
B01.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      original.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), original.new_year
        ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __customer_target_rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
)
SELECT
  customer_target_result.*
FROM (
  WITH source_rows AS (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY new_targetid) AS id_count
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_rank.*
      FROM (
        SELECT
          __x360_base.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY COALESCE(
              NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(__x360_base.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
              CAST(__x360_base.new_targetid AS TEXT)
            ), __x360_base.new_year
            ORDER BY __x360_base.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, __x360_base.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS version_rn
        FROM __customer_target_latest AS __x360_base
      ) AS __x360_rank
      WHERE
        __x360_rank.version_rn = 1
    ) AS t
    WHERE
      TRUE
  ), monthly AS (
    SELECT
      t.new_targetid,
      t.id_count,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
        THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
      END AS target_month,
      v.amount_yuan
    FROM source_rows AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1),
        (2, t.new_month2),
        (3, t.new_month3),
        (4, t.new_month4),
        (5, t.new_month5),
        (6, t.new_month6),
        (7, t.new_month7),
        (8, t.new_month8),
        (9, t.new_month9),
        (10, t.new_month10),
        (11, t.new_month11),
        (12, t.new_month12)
    ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      *
    FROM monthly
    WHERE
      target_month IS NOT NULL
       AND target_month >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)))
      AND target_month < CASE
        WHEN CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
        THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
      END
)
  SELECT
    SUM(amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS "YWLN_M0002"
  FROM scoped
) AS customer_target_result

B02.name: 实际销售额
B02.definition: 所选期间发货明细金额 new_amount_base 汇总（÷ 10^8），按发货单 new_shipping2_date 归期，仅数量 > 0 的发货行。
B02.rule: 销售额实绩口径（BR-Q01）；与出货量实绩同一发货事实来源。
B02.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), fact AS (
 SELECT
 i."new_ord_shipmentitemid" AS fact_id,
 s."new_shipping2_date"::timestamp AS shipped_at,
 i."new_amount_base" AS amount_cny,
 o."new_salesbg" AS product_line_code,
 CASE
 WHEN o."opportunityid" IS NULL THEN NULL
 WHEN o."new_accproducttype" IS NULL
 OR trim(o."new_accproducttype") = '' THEN 'OTHER'
 ELSE o."new_accproducttype"
 END AS product_type_code,
 o."new_accountlevel" AS customer_level_code,
 o."ownerid" AS owner_id,
 s."new_account_id" AS customer_id
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 ON s."new_ord_shipmentid" = i."new_ord_shipment_id"
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" so
 ON so."salesorderid" = s."new_salesorderid"
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o
 ON o."opportunityid" = so."opportunityid"
 WHERE i."new_qty" > 0
 AND s."new_shipping2_date"::timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
 SUM(f.amount_cny) / 100000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0001"
FROM fact f
WHERE 1 = 1
 AND f.shipped_at >= (SELECT start_date FROM parameters)
 AND f.shipped_at < (SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters)

B03.name: 目标出货量
B03.definition: 所选年度目标出货电量：目标 new_month1_power～12_power 按 kWh ÷ 10^6 换算 GWh。
B03.rule: 目标去重与电量换算按 BR-Q03（kWh ÷ 10^6）。
B03.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
    CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    t.team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
  JOIN __teams AS t
    ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM __owner_team_candidates
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
      t.new_year,
      CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
      t.new_month1_power,
      t.new_month2_power,
      t.new_month3_power,
      t.new_month4_power,
      t.new_month5_power,
      t.new_month6_power,
      t.new_month7_power,
      t.new_month8_power,
      t.new_month9_power,
      t.new_month10_power,
      t.new_month11_power,
      t.new_month12_power,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.rn = 1
), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003
  FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
    CASE
      WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
      THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
    END AS fact_date,
    CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    FALSE AS invalid,
    t.d002,
    COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
          THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
        END
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
      WHERE
        CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
    ) AS d004
  FROM __target_latest AS t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
    ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = t.account_id
  WHERE
    t.target_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
        AND CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END < CASE
          WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
      )
    )
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __target_facts
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
  FROM facts AS f
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
), aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh
  FROM scoped AS f
)
SELECT
  a.target_gwh AS "YWLN_M0007"
FROM aggregated AS a

B04.name: 实际出货量
B04.definition: 所选期间已发货数量 × 产品单套电量（kWh）÷ 10^6，按发货日期归期。
B04.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __once_new_ord_shipment_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT raw."new_qty",(raw."new_shipping2_date"||'') AS "new_shipping2_date",(raw."new_account_id"||'') AS "new_account_id",raw."statecode",(raw."new_ord_shipmentid"||'') AS "new_ord_shipmentid",(raw."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(raw."new_product_id"||'') AS "new_product_id",(raw."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" raw),
__once_account_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT raw."statecode",raw."new_accountlevel",(raw."name"||'') AS "name",(raw."accountid"||'') AS "accountid",(raw."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" raw),
__once_salesorder_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT raw."statecode",(raw."new_changetype"||'') AS "new_changetype",(raw."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",raw."new_amount",(raw."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",(raw."new_salesorderid"||'') AS "new_salesorderid",(raw."new_approval_time"||'') AS "new_approval_time",(raw."new_changestatus"||'') AS "new_changestatus",(raw."name"||'') AS "name",(raw."salesorderid"||'') AS "salesorderid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" raw),
__once_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (raw."new_ord_salesorder_id"||'') AS "new_ord_salesorder_id",raw."new_qty",(raw."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(raw."new_ord_shipmentitemid"||'') AS "new_ord_shipmentitemid",raw."statecode",(raw."new_ord_shipment_id"||'') AS "new_ord_shipment_id",(raw."new_product_id"||'') AS "new_product_id",raw."new_amount" ,raw."new_productcode" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" raw),
__once_product_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (raw."productid"||'') AS "productid",raw."statecode",(raw."name"||'') AS "name" ,raw."productnumber",raw."new_system_energy" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" raw),
__once_opportunity_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (raw."name"||'') AS "name",(raw."ownerid"||'') AS "ownerid",(raw."opportunityid"||'') AS "opportunityid",(raw."new_accountlevel"||'') AS "new_accountlevel",raw."statecode",(raw."new_accproducttype"||'') AS "new_accproducttype",(raw."new_salesbg"||'') AS "new_salesbg" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" raw),
__once_teammembership_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (raw."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(raw."systemuserid"||'') AS "systemuserid" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" raw),
__once_team_esb AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (raw."teamid"||'') AS "teamid",(raw."name"||'') AS "name" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" raw),
__status_required AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT FALSE 
  AS enabled
), __first_ship_once AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT i2.new_ord_salesorder_id AS new_salesorderid,MIN(s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp) AS shipped_at FROM __once_new_ord_shipment_esb s2 JOIN __once_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i2 ON i2.new_ord_shipment_id=s2.new_ord_shipmentid WHERE TRUE AND s2.statecode=0 AND s2.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(BTRIM(i2.new_ord_salesorder_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i2.new_ord_salesorder_id
), requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, __shipment_operating_requested_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text),''),
           NULLIF(btrim(s.new_salesorderid::text),'')) AS order_id
 FROM __once_new_ord_shipment_esb s
 JOIN __once_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i
  ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0
  AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
  AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR
       (s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp>=b.start_at
        AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<b.end_at))
), __shipment_operating_direct_links AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS order_id,
  NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid::text),'') AS opportunity_id
 FROM __once_salesorder_esb so
 JOIN __shipment_operating_requested_orders requested
  ON requested.order_id=so.salesorderid::text
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(so.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
), __shipment_operating_detail_links AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT l.salesorderid::text AS order_id,
  NULLIF(btrim(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') AS opportunity_id
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l
 JOIN __shipment_operating_requested_orders requested
  ON requested.order_id=l.salesorderid::text
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM __shipment_operating_direct_links direct_link
  WHERE direct_link.order_id=l.salesorderid::text
 )
), __shipment_operating_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,opportunity_id FROM __shipment_operating_direct_links
 UNION
 SELECT order_id,opportunity_id FROM __shipment_operating_detail_links
), __shipment_operating_owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.name::text AS team_name
 FROM __once_teammembership_esb tm
 JOIN __once_team_esb t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(t.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
), __shipment_operating_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT link.order_id,link.opportunity_id,
  o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL
   WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
   WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
   WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
   ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
  team.team_name
 FROM __shipment_operating_order_links link
 LEFT JOIN __once_opportunity_esb o ON o.opportunityid=link.opportunity_id
 LEFT JOIN __shipment_operating_owner_team_candidates team
  ON team.owner_id=o.ownerid::text
), __shipment_operating_order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT owner_id)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(owner_id)
   THEN MIN(owner_id) END AS owner_id,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(d002)
   THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(d003)
   THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(team_name)
   THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
 FROM __shipment_operating_dimension_candidates
 GROUP BY order_id
),
measure_rows AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.fact_id::text,f.fact_date::timestamp AS fact_date,(f.energy_kwh)::numeric/1000000::numeric AS metric_value,(COALESCE(f.source_issue,FALSE) OR COALESCE((f.energy_issue),FALSE) OR (f.energy_kwh) IS NULL) AS invalid,(FALSE) AS poison_time,f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,f.status_code,f.helmet_status AS helmet_status,f.resolved_team FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text,'MISSING_LINE:'||s.new_ord_shipmentid::text) AS fact_id,
 s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS fact_date,
 op_meta.d002 AS d002,
 op_meta.d003 AS d003,
 op_meta.owner_id AS owner_id,op_meta.team_name AS resolved_team,c.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(__account_lookup_1.name::text),'') AS d006,NULL::text AS status_code,
 CASE WHEN (SELECT enabled FROM __status_required) THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN ((so.statecode=0 AND NOT (so.statecode=2 OR COALESCE((so.new_changetype::text='4' AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)),FALSE)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __once_salesorder_esb cx WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
 AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))))) AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
 AND (first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL OR (first_ship.shipped_at>=so.new_approval_time::timestamp AND first_ship.shipped_at<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))) AND p.enabled AND p.cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL THEN
 CASE WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-so.new_approval_time::date) BETWEEN 0 AND p.imminent_days THEN 'imminent_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NULL AND p.cycle_target_days-((SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date-so.new_approval_time::date)>p.imminent_days THEN 'normal_uncompleted'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date>p.cycle_target_days THEN 'overdue_completed'
 WHEN first_ship.shipped_at IS NOT NULL AND first_ship.shipped_at::date-so.new_approval_time::date<=p.cycle_target_days THEN 'normal_completed' END END
 FROM (SELECT dimension_code,cycle_target_days,imminent_days,
 (cycle_target_days IS NOT NULL AND cycle_target_days>=0
  AND imminent_days IS NOT NULL AND imminent_days BETWEEN 0 AND cycle_target_days) AS enabled
FROM (
 SELECT dimension_code,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_CYCLE_TARGET_DAYS') AS cycle_target_days,
  max(config_value) FILTER(WHERE config_key=replace(dimension_code,'YWLN_','')||'_IMMINENT_DAYS') AS imminent_days
 FROM ded_public."x360_static_metric_config"
 WHERE config_set='MOCK' AND period_key='GLOBAL'
   AND config_group='HELMET' AND enabled
 GROUP BY dimension_code
) v) p WHERE p.dimension_code='YWLN_D024') END AS helmet_status,
 i.new_qty*pr.new_system_energy AS energy_kwh,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan,
 (i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NULL) AS source_issue,
 (pr.new_system_energy IS NULL OR pr.new_system_energy<=0) AS energy_issue
 FROM __once_new_ord_shipment_esb s
 LEFT JOIN __once_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 JOIN __once_product_esb pr ON pr.productnumber=i.new_productcode AND pr.new_system_energy>0
 LEFT JOIN __once_salesorder_esb so ON so.salesorderid=s.new_salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __shipment_operating_order_dimensions op_meta
  ON op_meta.order_id=COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text),''),
                               NULLIF(btrim(s.new_salesorderid::text),''))
 LEFT JOIN __first_ship_once first_ship ON first_ship.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid
 LEFT JOIN __once_account_esb c ON c.accountid=s.new_account_id
  LEFT JOIN __once_account_esb __account_lookup_1 ON __account_lookup_1.accountid::text=s.new_account_id::text
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
) f WHERE TRUE
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,f.resolved_team AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
)
SELECT (CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END) AS "YWLN_M0006" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()

B05.name: 年度时间消耗
B05.definition: 所选年度已过天数 ÷ 全年天数（0～1）。
B05.rule: 达成率与时间进度比较的基准（BR-Q06）。
B05.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), requested AS (

    SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at, NULL::timestamp AS end_at

    WHERE FALSE

    UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp), CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp)

), bounds AS (

    SELECT COALESCE(MAX(start_at), date_trunc('year', (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))) AS start_at,

           COALESCE(MAX(end_at), date_trunc('year', (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) + INTERVAL '1 year') AS end_at

    FROM requested

), years AS (

    SELECT gs::date AS year_start

    FROM bounds b

    CROSS JOIN generate_series(date_trunc('year', b.start_at), date_trunc('year', b.end_at - INTERVAL '1 day'), INTERVAL '1 year') gs

), months AS (

    SELECT gs::date AS month_start

    FROM bounds b

    CROSS JOIN generate_series(date_trunc('month', b.start_at), date_trunc('month', b.end_at - INTERVAL '1 day'), INTERVAL '1 month') gs

), year_ratio AS (

    SELECT y.year_start,

           CASE WHEN (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date < y.year_start THEN 0::numeric

                ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(1::numeric,

                    (LEAST((y.year_start + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date,

                            (SELECT (end_at - INTERVAL '1 day')::date FROM bounds), (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date)

                     - y.year_start + 1)::numeric

                    / ((y.year_start + INTERVAL '1 year')::date - y.year_start)::numeric))

           END AS ratio

    FROM years y

), month_ratio AS (

    SELECT m.month_start,

           CASE WHEN (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date < date_trunc('year', m.month_start)::date THEN 0::numeric

                ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(1::numeric,

                    (LEAST((m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date, (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date)

                     - date_trunc('year', m.month_start)::date + 1)::numeric

                    / ((date_trunc('year', m.month_start) + INTERVAL '1 year')::date

                       - date_trunc('year', m.month_start)::date)::numeric))

           END AS ratio

    FROM months m

)

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date < date_trunc('year', start_at)::date THEN 0::numeric

            ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, LEAST(1::numeric,

                (LEAST((end_at - INTERVAL '1 day')::date, (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)::date)

                 - date_trunc('year', start_at)::date + 1)::numeric

                / ((date_trunc('year', start_at) + INTERVAL '1 year')::date

                   - date_trunc('year', start_at)::date)::numeric))

       END AS "YWLN_M0009" FROM bounds

R01.name: 销售额达成率
R01.definition: B02 实际销售额 ÷ B01 目标销售额。
R01.rule: 与 B05 比较判定销售额进度（BR-A01）。
R01.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), __customer_target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      original.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(original.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(original.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), original.new_year
        ORDER BY original.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, original.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __customer_target_rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS original
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.__customer_target_rn = 1
)
SELECT
  customer_target_result.*
FROM (
  WITH __narrow_inline_0 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      t."new_qty",
      t."new_amount_base",
      (
        t."new_ord_shipmentitemid" || ''
      ) AS "new_ord_shipmentitemid",
      (
        t."new_ord_shipment_id" || ''
      ) AS "new_ord_shipment_id"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_1 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      t."new_shipping2_date",
      t."statecode",
      (
        t."new_ord_shipmentid" || ''
      ) AS "new_ord_shipmentid",
      (
        t."new_salesorderid" || ''
      ) AS "new_salesorderid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_2 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."opportunityid" || ''
      ) AS "opportunityid",
      (
        t."salesorderid" || ''
      ) AS "salesorderid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_3 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."ownerid" || ''
      ) AS "ownerid",
      (
        t."opportunityid" || ''
      ) AS "opportunityid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_4 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      t."new_target_type",
      t."new_year",
      t."new_month10",
      (
        t."ownerid" || ''
      ) AS "ownerid",
      t."new_month1",
      t."new_month2",
      t."new_month4",
      t."new_month5",
      t."statecode",
      t."new_month9",
      t."new_month11",
      t."new_month8",
      t."new_month6",
      t."new_month12",
      t."new_month3",
      (
        t."new_targetid" || ''
      ) AS "new_targetid",
      t."new_month7"
    FROM __customer_target_latest AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_5 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."teamid" || ''
      ) AS "teamid",
      (
        t."systemuserid" || ''
      ) AS "systemuserid"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS t
  ), __narrow_inline_6 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      (
        t."teamid" || ''
      ) AS "teamid",
      (
        t."name" || ''
      ) AS "name"
    FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb" AS t
  ), fact_distinct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS fact_id,
      CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
      i."new_amount_base" AS amount_yuan,
      o.ownerid AS owner_id,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d005
    FROM __narrow_inline_0 AS i
    JOIN __narrow_inline_1 AS s
      ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
    LEFT JOIN __narrow_inline_2 AS so
      ON so.salesorderid = s.new_salesorderid
    LEFT JOIN __narrow_inline_3 AS o
      ON o.opportunityid = so.opportunityid
    WHERE
      i.new_qty > 0 AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(ROW(t.new_targetid, v.month_no) AS TEXT)
      END AS fact_id,
      CASE
        WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999 AND t.new_year <> 0
        THEN MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1)
      END AS fact_date,
      v.amount_yuan,
      t.ownerid AS owner_id,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d003,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d005
    FROM __narrow_inline_4 AS t
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      VALUES
        (1, t.new_month1),
        (2, t.new_month2),
        (3, t.new_month3),
        (4, t.new_month4),
        (5, t.new_month5),
        (6, t.new_month6),
        (7, t.new_month7),
        (8, t.new_month8),
        (9, t.new_month9),
        (10, t.new_month10),
        (11, t.new_month11),
        (12, t.new_month12)
    ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan)
    WHERE
      TRUE
  ), fact_versions AS (
    SELECT
      *,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS id_copies
    FROM fact_distinct
  ), scoped AS (
    SELECT
      f.*,
      CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS d004
    FROM fact_versions AS f
    WHERE
      f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
       AND CASE
        WHEN f.kind IN ('TARGET')
        THEN f.fact_date >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP))
        ELSE f.fact_date >= CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END
      AND CASE
        WHEN f.kind IN ('TARGET')
        THEN f.fact_date < CASE
          WHEN CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
        ELSE f.fact_date < CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP)
      END
  ), aggregated AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL') = COUNT(fact_id) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
        AND NOT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(id_copies > 1) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL'), FALSE)
        THEN SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL')
      END AS numerator_yuan,
      SUM(amount_yuan) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'TARGET') AS target_yuan
    FROM scoped AS f
  )
  SELECT
    numerator_yuan / NULLIF(target_yuan, 0) AS "YWLN_M0003"
  FROM aggregated
) AS customer_target_result

R02.name: 出货量达成率
R02.definition: B04 实际出货量 ÷ B03 目标出货量。
R02.rule: 与 B05 比较判定出货进度（BR-A01）。
R02.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(name AS TEXT)) = 1 THEN MIN(CAST(name AS TEXT)) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS new_product_typeid,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS new_accproducttype
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.*,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), owner_team.team_name) AS __x360_target_team_name_20261114
  FROM (
    SELECT
      raw.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(raw.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''),
          CAST(raw.new_targetid AS TEXT)
        ), raw.new_year
        ORDER BY raw.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, raw.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS __x360_target_version_20261114
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS raw
    WHERE
      raw.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
  ) AS v
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = CAST(v.owningteam AS TEXT)
  LEFT JOIN __x360_target_align_20261114_owners AS owner_team
    ON owner_team.owner_id = CAST(v.ownerid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    v.__x360_target_version_20261114 = 1
), requested AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS start_at,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS end_at
  WHERE
    FALSE
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP),
    CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS TIMESTAMP) 
), bounds AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(start_at) AS start_at,
    MAX(end_at) AS end_at
  FROM requested
), __accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(accountid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS customer_level,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(name AS TEXT)), '') AS customer_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT),
    CAST(name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    t.team_name
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" AS tm
  JOIN __teams AS t
    ON t.teamid = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(t.team_name), '') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM __owner_team_candidates
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), __opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(opportunityid AS TEXT),
    CAST(ownerid AS TEXT),
    CAST(new_salesbg AS TEXT) AS d002,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003,
    CAST(new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS d005,
    CAST(parentaccountid AS TEXT)
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"
), __shipment_items AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS fact_date,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(s.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT)), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(s.new_salesorderid AS TEXT)), '')
    ) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" AS i
  JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" AS s
    ON s.new_ord_shipmentid = i.new_ord_shipment_id
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  WHERE
    i.new_qty > 0
    AND s.statecode = 0
    AND s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL
    AND s.new_shipping2_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) <= (SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= b.start_at
        AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < b.end_at
      )
    )
), __selected_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    order_id
  FROM __shipment_items
  WHERE
    order_id IS NOT NULL
), __direct_order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') AS opportunity_id
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" AS so
  JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
    ON requested.order_id = CAST(so.salesorderid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(so.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), __order_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    opportunity_id
  FROM __direct_order_links
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT),
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '')
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" AS l
  JOIN __selected_orders AS requested
    ON requested.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM __direct_order_links AS d
      WHERE
        d.order_id = CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)
    )
), __order_dimension_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    link.order_id,
    link.opportunity_id,
    o.ownerid,
    o.d002,
    o.d003,
    teams.team_name
  FROM __order_links AS link
  LEFT JOIN __opportunities AS o
    ON o.opportunityid = link.opportunity_id
  LEFT JOIN __owner_team_candidates AS teams
    ON teams.owner_id = o.ownerid
), __order_dimensions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ownerid) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(ownerid)
      THEN MIN(ownerid)
    END AS owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d002) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d002) THEN MIN(d002) END AS d002,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d003) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(d003) THEN MIN(d003) END AS d003,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT(team_name)
      THEN MIN(team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM __order_dimension_candidates
  GROUP BY
    order_id
), __product_energy AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p.new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(p.new_system_energy AS DECIMAL))
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb" AS p
  WHERE
    p.new_system_energy > 0
    AND EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM __shipment_items AS i
      WHERE
        i.product_code = CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(p.productnumber AS TEXT)
), __actual_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('ACTUAL' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    i.fact_id,
    i.fact_date,
    i.qty * p.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    (
      i.fact_id IS NULL OR p.energy_kwh IS NULL
    ) AS invalid,
    d.d002,
    d.d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    d.team_name AS d004
  FROM __shipment_items AS i
  JOIN __product_energy AS p
    ON p.product_code = i.product_code
  LEFT JOIN __order_dimensions AS d
    ON d.order_id = i.order_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = i.account_id
), __target_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
      t.new_year,
      CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(t.new_marketing_center AS TEXT) AS d002,
      CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
      CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team,
      t.new_month1_power,
      t.new_month2_power,
      t.new_month3_power,
      t.new_month4_power,
      t.new_month5_power,
      t.new_month6_power,
      t.new_month7_power,
      t.new_month8_power,
      t.new_month9_power,
      t.new_month10_power,
      t.new_month11_power,
      t.new_month12_power,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS t
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE
      b.start_at IS NULL OR t.new_year = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.start_at) AS INT)
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    ranked.rn = 1
), __product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS producttype_id,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL
      THEN '其他'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS d003
  FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_products AS p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
), __target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST('TARGET' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    t.target_id || ':' || CAST(v.month_no AS TEXT) AS fact_id,
    CASE
      WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
      THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
    END AS fact_date,
    CAST(v.power_kwh AS DECIMAL) / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS value_gwh,
    FALSE AS invalid,
    t.d002,
    COALESCE(pt.d003, '其他') AS d003,
    c.customer_level AS d005,
    c.customer_name AS d006,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114) = 1
          THEN MIN(c.__x360_target_team_name_20261114)
        END
      FROM __x360_target_align_20261114_data AS c
      WHERE
        CAST(c.new_targetid AS TEXT) = CAST(t.target_id AS TEXT)
    ) AS d004
  FROM __target_latest AS t
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, power_kwh)
  CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
  LEFT JOIN __product_types AS pt
    ON pt.producttype_id = t.producttype_id
  LEFT JOIN __accounts AS c
    ON c.accountid = t.account_id
  WHERE
    t.target_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      b.start_at IS NULL
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at)
        AND CASE
          WHEN t.new_year BETWEEN 1900 AND 9999
          THEN CAST(MAKE_DATE(CAST(t.new_year AS INT), v.month_no, 1) AS TIMESTAMP)
        END < CASE
          WHEN b.end_at IS NOT NULL
          THEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', b.start_at) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
        END
      )
    )
), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __actual_facts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    *
  FROM __target_facts
), checked AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY kind, fact_id) AS copies
  FROM facts AS f
), scoped AS (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    TO_CHAR(f.fact_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_key
  FROM checked AS f
  WHERE
    f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
), aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(
        BOOL_OR(f.invalid OR f.copies > 1 OR f.fact_id IS NULL) FILTER(WHERE
          kind = 'ACTUAL'),
        FALSE
      )
      THEN NULL
      ELSE SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        kind = 'ACTUAL')
    END AS actual_gwh,
    SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
      kind = 'TARGET') AS target_gwh
  FROM scoped AS f
)
SELECT
  a.actual_gwh / NULLIF(a.target_gwh, 0) AS "YWLN_M0008"
FROM aggregated AS a

R08.name: 还可出货量
R08.definition: 看板“还可出货量”：当月及以后商机月度预测可出货电量。
R08.rule: 与剩余目标比较，作为 RK05 的补充证据。
R08.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_selected_prediction_request AS (

 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at

  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 

), __x360_selected_prediction_bounds AS (

 SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM __x360_selected_prediction_request

)

SELECT __x360_period_result.* FROM (

WITH requested AS (SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT start_at,end_at FROM __x360_selected_prediction_bounds ),
bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested),
__accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT accountid::text,new_accountlevel::text AS customer_level,
  NULLIF(btrim(name::text),'') AS customer_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb"
), __teams AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT teamid::text,name::text AS team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb"
), __owner_team_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.team_name
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb" tm
 JOIN __teams t ON t.teamid=tm.teamid::text
 WHERE NULLIF(btrim(t.team_name),'') IS NOT NULL
), __owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT owner_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
 FROM __owner_team_candidates GROUP BY owner_id
),
__remaining_opportunity_source AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT opportunityid,ownerid,new_salesbg,new_accproducttype,new_accountlevel,parentaccountid,

        new_cellcapacity,new_cell_qty

 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb"

),

__opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT opportunityid::text,ownerid::text,new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
   WHEN new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
   WHEN new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
  new_accountlevel::text AS d005,parentaccountid::text
 FROM __remaining_opportunity_source
),
__forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT ranked.fact_id,ranked.opportunity_id,ranked.fact_date,ranked.qty,ranked.energy_kwh

 FROM (

  SELECT m.new_oppmonthid::text AS fact_id,m.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,

   m.new_accountdate::timestamp AS fact_date,

   m.new_shipforecast_qty::numeric AS qty,m.new_singlepower::numeric AS energy_kwh,

   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

    PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id::text,date_trunc('month',m.new_accountdate::timestamp)

    ORDER BY m.new_accountdate::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,m.createdon::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,

             m.modifiedon::timestamp DESC NULLS LAST,m.new_oppmonthid::text DESC NULLS LAST

   ) AS __remaining_month_latest_rn

  FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb" m CROSS JOIN bounds b

  WHERE NULLIF(btrim(m.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL

   AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp IS NOT NULL

   AND (b.start_at IS NULL OR

    (m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=b.start_at AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<b.end_at))

 ) ranked

 WHERE ranked.__remaining_month_latest_rn=1 AND ranked.fact_id IS NOT NULL

), __remaining_opp_energy_values AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,

  CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'

       WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' END AS product_type,

  o.new_cellcapacity::numeric AS cell_energy_kwh,o.new_cell_qty::numeric AS cells_per_set

 FROM __remaining_opportunity_source o

 WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __forecast_rows f WHERE f.opportunity_id=o.opportunityid::text)

), __remaining_opp_energy_by_type AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT opportunity_id,

  CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_type)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(product_type)

         AND COUNT(DISTINCT cell_energy_kwh)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(cell_energy_kwh)

         AND MIN(cell_energy_kwh)>0 THEN

   CASE WHEN MIN(product_type)='电芯' THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)

        WHEN MIN(product_type)='PACK'

         AND COUNT(DISTINCT cells_per_set)=1 AND COUNT(*)=COUNT(cells_per_set)

         AND MIN(cells_per_set)>0 THEN MIN(cell_energy_kwh)*MIN(cells_per_set) END

  END AS alternative_unit_kwh

 FROM __remaining_opp_energy_values GROUP BY opportunity_id

), __remaining_converted AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT f.fact_id,f.opportunity_id,f.fact_date,f.qty,

  CASE WHEN f.energy_kwh>0 THEN f.energy_kwh ELSE e.alternative_unit_kwh END AS unit_kwh

 FROM __forecast_rows f

 LEFT JOIN __remaining_opp_energy_by_type e ON e.opportunity_id=f.opportunity_id

), __forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT 'FORECAST'::text AS kind,f.fact_id,f.fact_date,

  CASE WHEN f.qty=0 THEN 0::numeric

       WHEN f.qty>0 AND f.unit_kwh>0 THEN f.qty*f.unit_kwh/1000000::numeric END AS value_gwh,

  (f.qty IS NULL OR f.qty<0 OR (f.qty>0 AND f.unit_kwh IS NULL)) AS invalid,

  o.d002,o.d003,o.d005,c.customer_name AS d006,teams.team_name AS d004

 FROM __remaining_converted f

 JOIN __opportunities o ON o.opportunityid=f.opportunity_id

 LEFT JOIN __accounts c ON c.accountid=o.parentaccountid

 LEFT JOIN __owner_teams teams ON teams.owner_id=o.ownerid

),

facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT * FROM __forecast_facts
),
checked AS (SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,fact_id) AS copies FROM facts f),
scoped AS (SELECT f.*,to_char(f.fact_date,'YYYY-MM') AS month_key FROM checked f WHERE f.fact_date IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (SELECT SUM(value_gwh) FILTER(WHERE kind='FORECAST' AND f.fact_id IS NOT NULL AND f.copies=1 AND NOT COALESCE(f.invalid,TRUE)) AS remaining_gwh FROM scoped f)
SELECT a.remaining_gwh AS "YWLN_M0010" FROM aggregated a
) AS __x360_period_result

O01.definition: 所选期间 OA 审批通过的有效订单行电量，按产品类型分组。
O01.rule: 有效订单口径（BR-Q04）；计算取消 / 变更占比的分母。

-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_ord_oa_state",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH order_distinct AS (

 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid AS fact_id,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,

 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,

 o.ownerid AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_so.name::text),'') AS d006,

 CASE WHEN (so.statecode=2 OR

 (so.new_changetype='4' AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx
 WHERE cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
 AND cx.new_changestatus='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)),FALSE)) THEN 'order_cancel'

 WHEN so.statecode=0 AND EXISTS (

 SELECT 1 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" cl

 WHERE cl.salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cl.salesorderdetailid IS NOT NULL AND (so.statecode=0 AND NOT COALESCE((so.statecode=2 OR

 ( so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx
 WHERE cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
 AND cx.new_changestatus='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)),FALSE)),FALSE)) AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AND cl.quantity>0 AND (cl.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR cl.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) AND (cl.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR cl.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))

 ) THEN 'order_change'

 WHEN so.statecode=0 THEN 'normal_order' END AS status_code, CASE WHEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::numeric END AS amount_yuan

 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_so ON acc_so.accountid = so.customerid LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid

 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL ), orders AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM order_distinct)

, fact_distinct AS (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(l.salesorderdetailid,'MISSING_LINE:'||r.fact_id) AS fact_id,r.fact_date,r.status_code,

 r.d002,r.d003,r.owner_id,r.d005,r.d006,CASE WHEN (so.statecode=0 AND NOT COALESCE((so.statecode=2 OR

 (so.new_changetype='4' AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) OR COALESCE(so.salesorderid IN (SELECT cx.new_salesorderid FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx
 WHERE cx.salesorderid<>cx.new_salesorderid
 AND cx.new_changestatus='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)),FALSE)),FALSE)) AND so.new_changestatus='8' AND so.new_changetype IN ('1','3','6','8') AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters) AND l.quantity>0 AND l.new_changepostqty>=0 AND l.new_changepostqty<l.quantity AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) THEN l.new_dischargecapacity*l.new_changepostqty/NULLIF(l.quantity,0) ELSE l.new_dischargecapacity END AS metric_value,r.copies AS source_copies

 FROM orders r JOIN __x360_gov_source_11 so ON so.salesorderid=r.fact_id LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_so ON acc_so.accountid = so.customerid

 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb" l ON l.salesorderid=r.fact_id

 WHERE r.status_code IN ('normal_order','order_change') AND (l.new_effectivedate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_effectivedate::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)) AND (l.new_expirydate::timestamp IS NULL OR l.new_expirydate::timestamp>(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))), metric_facts AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies FROM fact_distinct WHERE fact_date IS NOT NULL AND fact_date<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))

, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM metric_facts f WHERE 1=1

  AND f.fact_date>=CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp) AND f.fact_date<CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 

 )

SELECT f.d003 AS "YWLN_D003", CASE WHEN bool_or(f.metric_copies>1 OR f.source_copies>1 OR f.metric_value IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value)/1000000::numeric END AS "YWLN_M0032" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.d003
) AS __x360_gov_result

O02.name: 订单接收金额
O02.definition: 订单接收金额，按订单状态（正常订单 / 订单变更 / 订单取消）分组。
O02.rule: 订单状态取自 D016；取消包括系统状态 2 及已审批生效的取消变更。
O02.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH order_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (

 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid AS fact_id,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,

 CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,

 o.ownerid AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(acc_so.name::text),'') AS d006,

 CASE WHEN so.statecode=2 THEN 'order_cancel' WHEN so.statecode=0 AND so.new_changestatus='8' THEN 'order_change' WHEN so.statecode=0 THEN 'normal_order' END AS status_code, CASE WHEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::text ~ '^[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN ((so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax)::text)::numeric END AS amount_yuan

 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" acc_so ON acc_so.accountid = so.customerid LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid

 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL  AND so.createdon::timestamp>=CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp) AND so.createdon::timestamp<CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp)  

), orders AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS copies FROM order_distinct)

, fact_distinct AS (SELECT *,amount_yuan AS metric_value,(amount_yuan IS NULL) AS needs_value FROM orders WHERE status_code IN ('normal_order','order_change','order_cancel')), metric_facts AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY fact_id) AS metric_copies FROM fact_distinct)

, scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM metric_facts f  WHERE 1=1

 )

SELECT f.status_code AS "YWLN_D016", SUM(f.metric_value / NULLIF(f.metric_copies,0))/100000000::numeric AS "YWLN_M0033" FROM scoped f GROUP BY f.status_code
) AS __x360_gov_result

O03.name: 订单履约率
O03.definition: 按订单审批期间选有效已签订单，累计截至期末的已发货明细金额 ÷ 该批订单金额；取消订单两侧同排除。
O03.rule: 低于阈值判定履约不足（BR-A06）。
O03.sql:
-- 销售额／出货量共同问题分析 · 调用SQL（由看板查询模板渲染）；PostgreSQL 只读；无绑定参数。
-- 改统计期间只改 parameters 的 start_date / end_exclusive；observed_at 为观察时点（默认当前时间）；可选筛选已去除（全量口径）。
WITH parameters AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive, CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at), __x360_gov_source_11 AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT __x360_raw."salesorderid",__x360_raw."new_changetype",__x360_raw."new_changestatus",__x360_raw."new_salesordertype",__x360_raw."new_order_category",__x360_raw."new_amount",__x360_raw."new_ord_oa_state",__x360_raw."new_salesorderid",__x360_raw."ownerid",__x360_raw."name",__x360_raw."opportunityid",__x360_raw."customerid",__x360_raw."statecode",__x360_raw."createdon",__x360_raw."new_approval_time",__x360_raw."new_amount" AS "order_amount_rmb_ex_tax" FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb" __x360_raw)
SELECT * FROM (
WITH requested AS (
 SELECT NULL::timestamp AS start_at,NULL::timestamp AS end_at
  WHERE FALSE UNION ALL SELECT CAST((SELECT start_date FROM parameters) AS timestamp),CAST((SELECT end_exclusive FROM parameters) AS timestamp) 
), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(start_at) AS start_at,MAX(end_at) AS end_at FROM requested)
, fulfillment_orders_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT so.salesorderid::text AS order_id,so.createdon::timestamp AS fact_date,
  o.new_salesbg::text AS d002,
  CASE WHEN o.opportunityid IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.new_accproducttype::text),'') IS NULL THEN '其他'
   WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS d003,
  o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,o.new_accountlevel::text AS d005,NULLIF(btrim(a.name::text),'') AS d006,
  so.order_amount_rmb_ex_tax::numeric AS amount_yuan
 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 so
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb" o ON o.opportunityid=so.opportunityid
 LEFT JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb" a ON a.accountid=so.customerid
 WHERE so.salesorderid IS NOT NULL AND so.new_salesordertype::text='1' AND so.new_order_category::text IN ('1','3')
  AND so.statecode=0 AND so.new_ord_oa_state::text='5'
  AND so.createdon::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND so.createdon::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
  AND ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR so.createdon::timestamp>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds))
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR so.createdon::timestamp<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds))
  AND NOT COALESCE(TRUE AND so.new_changestatus::text='8' AND so.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters),FALSE)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM __x360_gov_source_11 cx WHERE cx.new_salesorderid=so.salesorderid AND cx.salesorderid<>so.salesorderid
   AND TRUE AND cx.new_changestatus::text='8' AND cx.new_approval_time::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters))
), fulfillment_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY order_id) AS source_copies FROM fulfillment_orders_distinct f
), fulfillment_shipments_distinct AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT DISTINCT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS shipment_item_id,s.new_salesorderid::text AS order_id,i.new_amount::numeric AS amount_yuan
 FROM ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb" s
 JOIN ded_public."p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb" i ON i.new_ord_shipment_id=s.new_ord_shipmentid AND i.new_qty>0
 WHERE s.new_ord_shipmentid IS NOT NULL AND s.statecode=0 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<=(SELECT observed_at FROM parameters)
  AND ((SELECT end_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_orders_distinct o WHERE o.order_id=s.new_salesorderid::text)
), fulfillment_shipments AS (
 SELECT f.*,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY shipment_item_id) AS source_copies FROM fulfillment_shipments_distinct f
), fulfillment_shipped_by_order AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_yuan) AS amount_yuan,BOOL_OR(amount_yuan IS NULL OR shipment_item_id IS NULL OR source_copies>1) AS invalid
 FROM fulfillment_shipments GROUP BY order_id
)
, measure_rows AS (
SELECT 'm0'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 COALESCE(s.amount_yuan,0)/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR COALESCE(s.invalid,FALSE)) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f LEFT JOIN fulfillment_shipped_by_order s ON s.order_id=f.order_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'm1'::text AS measure_tag,f.order_id AS fact_id,f.fact_date,
 f.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS metric_value,
 (f.source_copies>1 OR f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS invalid,FALSE AS poison_time,
 f.d002,f.d003,f.owner_id,f.d005,f.d006,NULL::text AS status_code,NULL::text AS helmet_status
FROM fulfillment_orders f
), checked AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY measure_tag,fact_id) AS fact_copies FROM measure_rows),
 scoped AS (SELECT f.*,NULL::text AS d004 FROM checked f 
 WHERE ((SELECT start_at FROM bounds) IS NULL OR (f.fact_date>=(SELECT start_at FROM bounds) AND f.fact_date<(SELECT end_at FROM bounds)) OR f.poison_time)
)
SELECT ((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m0') END))/NULLIF(((CASE WHEN COALESCE(bool_or(f.invalid OR f.fact_copies>1) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1'),FALSE) THEN NULL ELSE SUM(f.metric_value) FILTER(WHERE f.measure_tag='m1') END)),0) AS "YWLN_M0037" FROM scoped f GROUP BY ()
) AS __x360_gov_result
