OR01.name: 商机预测缺口
OR01.definition:
1117·B01 年度目标 −（进度＋预测）。缺口＝目标－（进度＋预测）。进度＝观察月以前各月已签单商机预测；预测＝观察当月至12月全部商机预测（含已签、未签）；进度＋预测即1117·R03明细的全年覆盖预测，取数分支与1117·R03、1117·R06相同（先筛截至观察日可用的预测记录，再按商机ID＋月份取最新版本）。不混入实际销售额或实际出货量。金额、电量分别计算，并输出缺口率＝缺口÷目标。
全年拼接覆盖仍为观察月以前各月已签预测＋观察当月至12月全部预测；前段仅取signed IS TRUE，后段不按已签/未签状态筛除。观察月由所选期间与观察日期的有效截止确定，不使用执行当天替代。 已签/未签统一执行BR-Q09：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。
OR01.rule:
缺口大于 0，即判为商机全年覆盖（进度＋预测）不足；等级按缺口率。目标缺失或为 0 时缺口率保持 NULL。
目标、预测及关联客户/商机均按同一观察日期限定可见性；原阈值、缺值保护及正负差额方式保持。
OR01.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), forecasts_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        owner_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
            ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS rn
        FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
        ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            owner_id
          FROM storage_opportunity_owners
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            team_id
          FROM storage_team_ids
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY a.accountid
          ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM customer_latest
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
        SELECT
          user_id
        FROM storage_user_ids
      )
  )
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS total_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS total_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        signed)
    END AS signed_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        signed)
    END AS signed_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT signed)
    END AS unsigned_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT signed) AS unsigned_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        (
          NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
            p.focus_levels
          )
        )
        AND account_id IN (
          SELECT
            account_id
          FROM storage_customer_ids
        )) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        (
          NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
            p.focus_levels
          )
        )
        AND account_id IN (
          SELECT
            account_id
          FROM storage_customer_ids
        ))
    END AS focus_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        (
          NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
            p.focus_levels
          )
        )
        AND account_id IN (
          SELECT
            account_id
          FROM storage_customer_ids
        )) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        (
          NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
            p.focus_levels
          )
        )
        AND account_id IN (
          SELECT
            account_id
          FROM storage_customer_ids
        ))
    END AS focus_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      (
        NOT signed AND level_code = ANY(
          p.focus_levels
        )
      )
      AND account_id IN (
        SELECT
          account_id
        FROM storage_customer_ids
      )) AS focus_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      missing_p3_end) AS missing_p3_end_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      missing_p3_end) AS missing_p3_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS fact_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), targets_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), base_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.product_type, f.product_type) AS product_type,
    t.target_amount,
    t.target_energy,
    t.target_missing_amount_rows,
    t.target_missing_energy_rows,
    f.total_amount,
    f.total_energy,
    f.signed_amount,
    f.signed_energy,
    f.unsigned_amount,
    f.unsigned_energy,
    f.focus_amount,
    f.focus_energy,
    f.unsigned_count,
    f.focus_count,
    f.missing_p3_end_count,
    f.missing_p3_end_rows,
    f.fact_rows,
    f.missing_amount_rows,
    f.missing_energy_rows,
    t.target_amount - f.total_amount AS gap_amount,
    t.target_energy - f.total_energy AS gap_energy,
    f.signed_amount / NULLIF(t.target_amount, 0) AS signed_progress_amount,
    f.signed_energy / NULLIF(t.target_energy, 0) AS signed_progress_energy
  FROM targets_by_product AS t
  FULL JOIN forecasts_by_product AS f
    USING (product_type)
), annual_risk_forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.year_start
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.next_year_start
    AND CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < p.as_of_exclusive
), annual_risk_forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.signed,
    o.missing_p3_end,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    (
      f.forecast_month >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', p.effective_end_exclusive - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND')
      OR o.signed
    ) AS included_in_annual_coverage
  FROM annual_risk_forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), annual_risk_coverage_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS annual_latest_forecast_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      missing_p3_end) AS annual_missing_p3_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      missing_p3_end AND NOT included_in_annual_coverage) AS annual_past_missing_p3_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      included_in_annual_coverage) AS annual_included_forecast_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      NOT included_in_annual_coverage) AS annual_excluded_past_unsigned_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      included_in_annual_coverage AND amount_yi IS NULL) AS annual_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      included_in_annual_coverage AND energy_gwh IS NULL) AS annual_missing_energy_rows,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        included_in_annual_coverage) = 0
      THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      ELSE SUM(amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
        included_in_annual_coverage)
    END AS annual_coverage_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        included_in_annual_coverage) = 0
      THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      ELSE SUM(energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
        included_in_annual_coverage)
    END AS annual_coverage_energy
  FROM annual_risk_forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        product_type
      )
    )
), annual_risk_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.product_type, c.product_type) AS product_type,
    t.target_amount AS annual_target_amount,
    t.target_energy AS annual_target_energy,
    c.annual_missing_p3_end_rows,
    c.annual_past_missing_p3_end_rows,
    c.annual_latest_forecast_rows,
    c.annual_included_forecast_rows,
    c.annual_excluded_past_unsigned_rows,
    c.annual_missing_amount_rows,
    c.annual_missing_energy_rows,
    c.annual_coverage_amount,
    c.annual_coverage_energy,
    CASE WHEN t.target_amount > 0 THEN c.annual_coverage_amount / t.target_amount END AS annual_coverage_amount_ratio,
    CASE WHEN t.target_energy > 0 THEN c.annual_coverage_energy / t.target_energy END AS annual_coverage_energy_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN t.target_amount > 0
      THEN (
        t.target_amount - c.annual_coverage_amount
      ) / t.target_amount
    END AS annual_amount_gap_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN t.target_energy > 0
      THEN (
        t.target_energy - c.annual_coverage_energy
      ) / t.target_energy
    END AS annual_energy_gap_ratio
  FROM targets_by_product AS t
  FULL JOIN annual_risk_coverage_by_product AS c
    USING (product_type)
), annual_risk_split AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(f.product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE f.product_type END AS product_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        SUM(f.amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
          f.signed
          AND f.forecast_month < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', p.effective_end_exclusive - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND')),
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      )
    END AS progress_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        SUM(f.energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          f.signed
          AND f.forecast_month < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', p.effective_end_exclusive - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND')),
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      )
    END AS progress_energy,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        SUM(f.amount_yi) FILTER(WHERE
          f.forecast_month >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', p.effective_end_exclusive - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND')),
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      )
    END AS forecast_amount,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) = 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE COALESCE(
        SUM(f.energy_gwh) FILTER(WHERE
          f.forecast_month >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', p.effective_end_exclusive - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND')),
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL)
      )
    END AS forecast_energy
  FROM annual_risk_forecast_facts AS f
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        f.product_type
      )
    )
), annual_risk_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    v.product_type,
    v.annual_missing_p3_end_rows,
    v.annual_past_missing_p3_end_rows,
    v.annual_target_amount AS target_amount,
    v.annual_target_energy AS target_energy,
    s.progress_amount,
    s.progress_energy,
    s.forecast_amount,
    s.forecast_energy,
    v.annual_coverage_amount AS coverage_amount,
    v.annual_coverage_energy AS coverage_energy,
    v.annual_target_amount - v.annual_coverage_amount AS gap_amount,
    v.annual_target_energy - v.annual_coverage_energy AS gap_energy,
    v.annual_amount_gap_ratio AS gap_rate_amount,
    v.annual_energy_gap_ratio AS gap_rate_energy
  FROM annual_risk_values AS v
  LEFT JOIN annual_risk_split AS s
    USING (product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    3 AS sort_no,
    CAST('R01' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('商机预测缺口' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      g.gap_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      g.gap_energy
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      g.gap_rate_amount
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('缺口＝同口径年度目标－（进度＋预测）；进度＝观察月以前已签单商机预测，预测＝观察月至年底全部商机预测，与R03全年覆盖预测同一分支。金额、电量独立；目标或必要输入缺失时差额NULL，不以0代替未知；比率列为金额缺口率。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v) ORDER BY v.product_type)
        FROM annual_risk_gaps AS v
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM annual_risk_gaps AS g
  WHERE
    g.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;
OR01.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
OR01.boardCaliber: 不适用：沿用商机获取本体 1117 调用SQL

OR08.name: 客户目标、商机预测及缺口
OR08.definition: 按客户ID汇总客户全部年度目标、进度和剩余预测后，分别计算金额缺口与电量缺口；各自缺口>0的客户构成风险专用正缺口集合。每客户一行，目标、进度、预测、总覆盖预测和缺口使用同一客户集合。
OR08.rule: 仅按OR08明细中唯一的“风险专用正缺口汇总”判断：金额口径或电量口径的正缺口客户数>0即成立。先按客户ID汇总同一客户全部年度目标、进度和剩余预测，再分别计算金额缺口和电量缺口；各口径仅筛客户汇总缺口>0的客户集合，客户数按客户ID去重。目标、进度、剩余预测、总覆盖预测和缺口必须读取各口径同一正缺口客户集合的SQL汇总；同一客户的全部目标和预测先合并，不拆分后先筛子集，也不用其他客户的负缺口抵销正缺口。不得按明细数组长度判定。1117·R04有未签商机或1117·R09有无商机客户仅为原因事实，不能单独OR触发客户目标不足。必要输入缺失按缺失说明处理，不把未知补成0。
OR08.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
),
annual_risk_forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP)) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.year_start
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.next_year_start
    AND CAST(m.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < p.as_of_exclusive
),
risk_customer_target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
),
risk_customer_target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.account_id,
 CAST(v.amount_yuan AS numeric)/1e8::numeric AS amount_yi,
 CAST(v.power_value AS numeric)/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
 FROM risk_customer_target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(VALUES
  (1,t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),(2,t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
  (3,t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),(4,t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
  (5,t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),(6,t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
  (7,t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),(8,t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
  (9,t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),(10,t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
  (11,t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),(12,t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)
 )v(month_no,amount_yuan,power_value)
 WHERE t.rn=1 AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)>=p.year_start
  AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)<p.next_year_start
),
customer_target AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL)=0 THEN SUM(amount_yi) END AS target_amount,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL)=0 THEN SUM(energy_gwh) END AS target_energy
 FROM risk_customer_target_facts GROUP BY account_id
),
customer_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.account_id,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE o.missing_p3_end) AS annual_missing_p3_end_rows,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE o.missing_p3_end AND f.forecast_month<DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond')) AS annual_past_missing_p3_end_rows,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE o.signed AND f.forecast_month<DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond') AND f.amount_yuan IS NULL)=0
  THEN COALESCE(SUM(f.amount_yuan/1e8::numeric)FILTER(WHERE o.signed AND f.forecast_month<DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond')),0::numeric) END AS progress_amount,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE o.signed AND f.forecast_month<DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond') AND (f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price=0))=0
  THEN COALESCE(SUM(f.amount_yuan/NULLIF(f.wh_price,0)/1e9::numeric)FILTER(WHERE o.signed AND f.forecast_month<DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond')),0::numeric) END AS progress_energy,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE f.forecast_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond') AND f.amount_yuan IS NULL)=0
  THEN COALESCE(SUM(f.amount_yuan/1e8::numeric)FILTER(WHERE f.forecast_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond')),0::numeric) END AS forecast_amount,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE f.forecast_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond') AND (f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price=0))=0
  THEN COALESCE(SUM(f.amount_yuan/NULLIF(f.wh_price,0)/1e9::numeric)FILTER(WHERE f.forecast_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond')),0::numeric) END AS forecast_energy
 FROM annual_risk_forecast_rows f JOIN opportunity_flags o USING(opportunity_id)
 CROSS JOIN context p WHERE f.rn=1 GROUP BY o.account_id
),
customer_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        owner_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
            ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS rn
        FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
        ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            owner_id
          FROM storage_opportunity_owners
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            team_id
          FROM storage_team_ids
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY a.accountid
          ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM customer_latest
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
        SELECT
          user_id
        FROM storage_user_ids
      )
  )
SELECT k.account_id,a.account_name,
 f.annual_missing_p3_end_rows,f.annual_past_missing_p3_end_rows,
 t.target_amount,f.progress_amount,f.forecast_amount,
 f.progress_amount+f.forecast_amount AS coverage_amount,
 t.target_amount-(f.progress_amount+f.forecast_amount) AS gap_amount,
 t.target_energy,f.progress_energy,f.forecast_energy,
 f.progress_energy+f.forecast_energy AS coverage_energy,
 t.target_energy-(f.progress_energy+f.forecast_energy) AS gap_energy
 FROM(SELECT account_id FROM customer_target WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT account_id FROM customer_forecast WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL)k
 JOIN accounts a USING(account_id)
 LEFT JOIN customer_target t USING(account_id)
 LEFT JOIN customer_forecast f USING(account_id)
 WHERE a.account_id IN(SELECT account_id FROM storage_customer_ids)
),
risk_forecast_input_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.account_id,COUNT(*) AS coverage_rows,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price=0) AS missing_energy_rows
 FROM annual_risk_forecast_rows f JOIN opportunity_flags o USING(opportunity_id) CROSS JOIN context p
 WHERE f.rn=1 AND(o.signed OR f.forecast_month>=DATE_TRUNC('month',p.effective_end_exclusive-INTERVAL '1 microsecond'))
 GROUP BY o.account_id
),
risk_target_input_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,COUNT(*) AS target_cells,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_cells,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_cells
 FROM risk_customer_target_facts GROUP BY account_id
),
customer_risk_input_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT g.account_id,t.target_cells,t.missing_amount_cells,t.missing_energy_cells,
 f.coverage_rows,f.missing_amount_rows,f.missing_energy_rows,
 (COALESCE(t.missing_amount_cells=0,FALSE) AND CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.coverage_rows,0)=0 THEN g.coverage_amount IS NOT NULL ELSE f.missing_amount_rows=0 END) AS amount_complete,
 (COALESCE(t.missing_energy_cells=0,FALSE) AND CASE WHEN COALESCE(f.coverage_rows,0)=0 THEN g.coverage_energy IS NOT NULL ELSE f.missing_energy_rows=0 END) AS energy_complete
 FROM customer_gaps g LEFT JOIN risk_target_input_quality t USING(account_id)
 LEFT JOIN risk_forecast_input_quality f USING(account_id)
),
customer_positive_gap_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
 '任一口径正缺口客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE (gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete) OR (gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete)),
 '金额口径',JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('缺口客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '战略客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete AND a.level_code=ANY(p.strategic_levels)),
  '重点客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete AND a.level_code='2'),
  '客户等级未知数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete AND (NULLIF(TRIM(a.level_code),'') IS NULL OR a.level_code NOT IN('0','1','2','3','4'))),
  '目标金额_亿元',SUM(target_amount)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '进度金额_亿元',SUM(progress_amount)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '剩余预测金额_亿元',SUM(forecast_amount)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '总覆盖预测金额_亿元',SUM(coverage_amount)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '缺口金额_亿元',SUM(gap_amount)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete),
  '缺口不可计算客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_amount IS NULL OR NOT q.amount_complete)),
 '电量口径',JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('缺口客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '战略客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete AND a.level_code=ANY(p.strategic_levels)),
  '重点客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete AND a.level_code='2'),
  '客户等级未知数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete AND (NULLIF(TRIM(a.level_code),'') IS NULL OR a.level_code NOT IN('0','1','2','3','4'))),
  '目标电量_GWh',SUM(target_energy)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '进度电量_GWh',SUM(progress_energy)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '剩余预测电量_GWh',SUM(forecast_energy)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '总覆盖预测电量_GWh',SUM(coverage_energy)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '缺口电量_GWh',SUM(gap_energy)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete),
  '缺口不可计算客户数',COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE gap_energy IS NULL OR NOT q.energy_complete)),
 '输入质量',JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('目标金额缺失单元格数',SUM(q.missing_amount_cells),'目标电量缺失单元格数',SUM(q.missing_energy_cells),
  '覆盖预测金额缺失记录数',SUM(q.missing_amount_rows),'覆盖预测电量缺失记录数',SUM(q.missing_energy_rows)),
 '使用说明','先按客户ID合计全部目标、进度及剩余预测，再判断正缺口；同一客户内部可抵扣，不跨客户抵扣。金额电量客户集合独立，缺失输入不当作确定缺口。') AS risk_summary
 FROM customer_gaps g JOIN customer_risk_input_quality q USING(account_id)
 JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
),
metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT 9 AS sort_no,'R08'::text AS code,'客户目标、商机预测及缺口'::text AS metric_name,
 NULL::text AS product_team,
 SUM(g.gap_amount)FILTER(WHERE g.gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete) AS amount_yi,
 SUM(g.gap_energy)FILTER(WHERE g.gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete) AS energy_gwh,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE (g.gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete) OR (g.gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete))::bigint AS item_count,
 NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 '已按客户汇总；正缺口及输入完整性见明细'::text AS status,
 '仅原储能客户名单内，先按客户ID合计全部年度目标、进度和剩余预测，再分别判断金额/电量正缺口。同客户内部可抵扣，不跨客户抵扣。主金额/电量为各自完整正缺口客户合计；主数量为两口径正缺口客户并集。进度为观察月以前已签预测，剩余为观察月至年底全部预测；单侧或输入缺失保留NULL。'::text AS note,
 COALESCE(JSONB_AGG((TO_JSONB(g)-'__summary_order')||JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
  '金额输入完整',q.amount_complete,'电量输入完整',q.energy_complete,
  '金额目标支撑率_原始小数',g.coverage_amount/NULLIF(g.target_amount,0),
  '金额目标支撑率_百分比数值',g.coverage_amount/NULLIF(g.target_amount,0)*100,
  '电量目标支撑率_原始小数',g.coverage_energy/NULLIF(g.target_energy,0),
  '电量目标支撑率_百分比数值',g.coverage_energy/NULLIF(g.target_energy,0)*100)
  ||CASE WHEN g.__summary_order=1 THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('风险专用正缺口汇总',(SELECT risk_summary FROM customer_positive_gap_summary)) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ORDER BY g.account_id),
  JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('风险专用正缺口汇总',(SELECT risk_summary FROM customer_positive_gap_summary)))) AS detail
 FROM(SELECT x.*,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY account_id) AS __summary_order FROM customer_gaps x)g
 JOIN customer_risk_input_quality q USING(account_id)
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

OR12.name: 商机获取阶段超期商机数及预测量
OR12.definition: P0（createdon→new_stage1enddate）完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的阶段中，0<超静态基线比例<50%的商机数与期间预测。本阶段静态基线为32.6天，同一阶段统一使用，不随所选期间或样本变化。
OR12.rule: 以本阶段结束时间归期，开始可跨年；使用P0固定基线32.6天，逐笔计算(实际天数－静态基线)÷静态基线。只计完整已结束且严格正周期，0天、缺值、逆序及未结束不参与。OR12/OR14/OR16为0<超基线比例<50%并列展示，OR13/OR15/OR17为超基线比例>=50%触发原风险；同一阶段统一使用该静态基线。不同阶段可重复命中，跨阶段合计须区分阶段累加和商机去重。结束还须早于观察日次日，缺预测不排除周期样本，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。 展示档位为“超期”，并列展示。
OR12.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), dynamic_stage_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), CAST('商机获取' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), CAST('技术交流' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), CAST('方案推动' AS TEXT))) AS v(stage_code, stage_name)
), dynamic_stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    b.stage_code,
    b.stage_name,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NULL
      THEN '缺阶段开始时间；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at < v.started_at
      THEN '日期逆序；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at = v.started_at THEN '零周期；不参与周期及分档'
      ELSE '所选期间已结束；使用严格大于0的完整实际周期'
    END AS timing_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    ON b.stage_code = v.stage_code
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1
    AND v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), dynamic_stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,stage_name,product_type,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS actual_mean_days,
    COUNT(duration_days)::bigint AS baseline_samples
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts
  GROUP BY stage_code,stage_name,product_type
), dynamic_stage_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    f.*,
    m.baseline_days,
    m.baseline_samples,
    (duration_days-baseline_days) AS excess_days,
  (duration_days-baseline_days)/NULLIF(baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN baseline_days IS NULL OR baseline_days <= 0 OR duration_days IS NULL
      THEN CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days > baseline_days
      AND duration_days < baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days >= baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days IS NOT NULL
      THEN CAST('NOT_OVERDUE' AS TEXT)
      ELSE CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
    END AS band_code
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts AS f
  JOIN dynamic_stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, stage_name, product_type)
), dynamic_stage_evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    ofc.forecast_rows,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    ofc.missing_amount_rows,
    ofc.missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS f
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
), dynamic_stage_metric_map AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (
      80,
      CAST('R12' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      81,
      CAST('R13' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      82,
      CAST('R14' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      83,
      CAST('R15' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      84,
      CAST('R16' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      85,
      CAST('R17' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    )) AS v(sort_no, code, metric_name, stage_code, band_code)
), severe_stage_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(h.stage_record_count),0)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.opportunity_id IS NULL) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stage_code) FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50') AS hit_stage_count
  FROM (
    SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*)::bigint AS stage_record_count
    FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50'
    GROUP BY opportunity_id
  ) h
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast f USING(opportunity_id)
), severe_stage_by_stage AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.stage_code,d.stage_name,
    CASE d.stage_code WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(f.forecast_rows,0)=0) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_definitions d
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence f ON f.stage_code=d.stage_code AND f.band_code='GE50'
  GROUP BY d.stage_code,d.stage_name
), dynamic_stage_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(SUM(f.amount_yi) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.opportunity_id) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(f.opportunity_id) > 0
      THEN '已输出命中数量；预测完整性见明细'
      WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.band_code IS NULL
      )
      THEN '未命中；部分时间不足或静态基线不可用，不能判为全部正常'
      ELSE '所选期间无命中商机'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('阶段静态基线：P0=32.6天、P1=21.8天、P2=7.2天、P3=57.2天、P4=15.3天，同阶段各产品共用基线；结束归期且仅周期>0参与分档。比例=(实际天数-静态基线)/静态基线；预测先聚合到商机，不影响周期样本。 LT50展示为超期，GE50展示为严重超期。严重超期跨阶段总览先按商机ID去重，再关联期间预测汇总金额及电量；阶段记录数和去重商机数分别列示，分阶段金额不可直接相加作为去重总金额。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '阶段',
      b.stage_name,
      '档位', m.band_code,
      '档位名称', CASE m.band_code WHEN 'LT50' THEN '超期' WHEN 'GE50' THEN '严重超期' END,
      '严重超期汇总_跨阶段去重', (SELECT TO_JSONB(s) FROM severe_stage_summary s),
      '严重超期分阶段汇总', (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(s) ORDER BY s.stage_code) FROM severe_stage_by_stage s),
      '各产品静态基线及有效正周期样本数',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('产品类型', d.product_type, '静态基线天', d.baseline_days, '有效正周期样本数', d.baseline_samples) ORDER BY d.product_type
          )
        FROM dynamic_stage_means AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '期间阶段记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '阶段日期不足记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.duration_days IS NULL
      ),
      '静态基线缺失或非正记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
          AND (
            d.baseline_days IS NULL OR d.baseline_days <= 0
          )
      ),
      '命中商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id),
      '有期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) > 0),
      '无期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) = 0),
      '命中商机金额不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.amount_yi IS NULL),
      '命中商机电量不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.energy_gwh IS NULL),
      '预测金额为空记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows), 0),
      '预测电量输入缺失记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows), 0),
      '预测合计说明',
      'SUM忽略单个NULL；缺失统计非零时金额或电量可能是部分合计；全部缺失保留NULL，不补0。',
      '商机明细',
      COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            '商机ID',
            f.opportunity_id,
            '产品',
            f.product_type,
            '截至日阶段推断',
            f.process_stage,
            '阶段开始',
            f.started_at,
            '阶段结束',
            f.finished_at,
            '计时状态',
            f.timing_status,
            '实际天数',
            f.duration_days,
            '基线天数', f.baseline_days,
            '超出基线天数', f.excess_days,
            '有效正周期样本数',
            f.baseline_samples,
            '超基线比例_原始小数',
            f.excess_ratio,
            '超基线百分比数值',
            f.excess_ratio * 100,
            '预测金额_亿元',
            f.amount_yi,
            '预测电量_GWh',
            f.energy_gwh
          ) ORDER BY f.duration_days DESC, f.opportunity_id
        ) FILTER(WHERE
          f.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL),
        CAST('[]' AS JSONB)
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM dynamic_stage_metric_map AS m
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    USING (stage_code)
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence AS f
    ON f.stage_code = m.stage_code AND f.band_code = m.band_code
  GROUP BY
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    m.stage_code,
    m.band_code,
    b.stage_name
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM dynamic_stage_results
  WHERE
    code = 'R12'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  r.status AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;
