OR16.name: 方案推动阶段超期商机数及预测量
OR16.definition: P2（new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate）完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的阶段中，0<超静态基线比例<50%的商机数与期间预测。本阶段静态基线为7.2天，同一阶段统一使用，不随所选期间或样本变化。
OR16.rule: 以本阶段结束时间归期，开始可跨年；使用P2固定基线7.2天，逐笔计算(实际天数－静态基线)÷静态基线。只计完整已结束且严格正周期，0天、缺值、逆序及未结束不参与。OR12/OR14/OR16为0<超基线比例<50%并列展示，OR13/OR15/OR17为超基线比例>=50%触发原风险；同一阶段统一使用该静态基线。不同阶段可重复命中，跨阶段合计须区分阶段累加和商机去重。结束还须早于观察日次日，缺预测不排除周期样本，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。 展示档位为“超期”，并列展示。
OR16.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), dynamic_stage_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), CAST('商机获取' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), CAST('技术交流' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), CAST('方案推动' AS TEXT))) AS v(stage_code, stage_name)
), dynamic_stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    b.stage_code,
    b.stage_name,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NULL
      THEN '缺阶段开始时间；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at < v.started_at
      THEN '日期逆序；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at = v.started_at THEN '零周期；不参与周期及分档'
      ELSE '所选期间已结束；使用严格大于0的完整实际周期'
    END AS timing_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    ON b.stage_code = v.stage_code
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1
    AND v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), dynamic_stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,stage_name,product_type,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS actual_mean_days,
    COUNT(duration_days)::bigint AS baseline_samples
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts
  GROUP BY stage_code,stage_name,product_type
), dynamic_stage_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    f.*,
    m.baseline_days,
    m.baseline_samples,
    (duration_days-baseline_days) AS excess_days,
  (duration_days-baseline_days)/NULLIF(baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN baseline_days IS NULL OR baseline_days <= 0 OR duration_days IS NULL
      THEN CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days > baseline_days
      AND duration_days < baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days >= baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days IS NOT NULL
      THEN CAST('NOT_OVERDUE' AS TEXT)
      ELSE CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
    END AS band_code
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts AS f
  JOIN dynamic_stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, stage_name, product_type)
), dynamic_stage_evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    ofc.forecast_rows,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    ofc.missing_amount_rows,
    ofc.missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS f
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
), dynamic_stage_metric_map AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (
      80,
      CAST('R12' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      81,
      CAST('R13' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      82,
      CAST('R14' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      83,
      CAST('R15' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      84,
      CAST('R16' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      85,
      CAST('R17' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    )) AS v(sort_no, code, metric_name, stage_code, band_code)
), severe_stage_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(h.stage_record_count),0)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.opportunity_id IS NULL) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stage_code) FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50') AS hit_stage_count
  FROM (
    SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*)::bigint AS stage_record_count
    FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50'
    GROUP BY opportunity_id
  ) h
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast f USING(opportunity_id)
), severe_stage_by_stage AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.stage_code,d.stage_name,
    CASE d.stage_code WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(f.forecast_rows,0)=0) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_definitions d
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence f ON f.stage_code=d.stage_code AND f.band_code='GE50'
  GROUP BY d.stage_code,d.stage_name
), dynamic_stage_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(SUM(f.amount_yi) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.opportunity_id) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(f.opportunity_id) > 0
      THEN '已输出命中数量；预测完整性见明细'
      WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.band_code IS NULL
      )
      THEN '未命中；部分时间不足或静态基线不可用，不能判为全部正常'
      ELSE '所选期间无命中商机'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('阶段静态基线：P0=32.6天、P1=21.8天、P2=7.2天、P3=57.2天、P4=15.3天，同阶段各产品共用基线；结束归期且仅周期>0参与分档。比例=(实际天数-静态基线)/静态基线；预测先聚合到商机，不影响周期样本。 LT50展示为超期，GE50展示为严重超期。严重超期跨阶段总览先按商机ID去重，再关联期间预测汇总金额及电量；阶段记录数和去重商机数分别列示，分阶段金额不可直接相加作为去重总金额。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '阶段',
      b.stage_name,
      '档位', m.band_code,
      '档位名称', CASE m.band_code WHEN 'LT50' THEN '超期' WHEN 'GE50' THEN '严重超期' END,
      '严重超期汇总_跨阶段去重', (SELECT TO_JSONB(s) FROM severe_stage_summary s),
      '严重超期分阶段汇总', (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(s) ORDER BY s.stage_code) FROM severe_stage_by_stage s),
      '各产品静态基线及有效正周期样本数',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('产品类型', d.product_type, '静态基线天', d.baseline_days, '有效正周期样本数', d.baseline_samples) ORDER BY d.product_type
          )
        FROM dynamic_stage_means AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '期间阶段记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '阶段日期不足记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.duration_days IS NULL
      ),
      '静态基线缺失或非正记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
          AND (
            d.baseline_days IS NULL OR d.baseline_days <= 0
          )
      ),
      '命中商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id),
      '有期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) > 0),
      '无期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) = 0),
      '命中商机金额不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.amount_yi IS NULL),
      '命中商机电量不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.energy_gwh IS NULL),
      '预测金额为空记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows), 0),
      '预测电量输入缺失记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows), 0),
      '预测合计说明',
      'SUM忽略单个NULL；缺失统计非零时金额或电量可能是部分合计；全部缺失保留NULL，不补0。',
      '商机明细',
      COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            '商机ID',
            f.opportunity_id,
            '产品',
            f.product_type,
            '截至日阶段推断',
            f.process_stage,
            '阶段开始',
            f.started_at,
            '阶段结束',
            f.finished_at,
            '计时状态',
            f.timing_status,
            '实际天数',
            f.duration_days,
            '基线天数', f.baseline_days,
            '超出基线天数', f.excess_days,
            '有效正周期样本数',
            f.baseline_samples,
            '超基线比例_原始小数',
            f.excess_ratio,
            '超基线百分比数值',
            f.excess_ratio * 100,
            '预测金额_亿元',
            f.amount_yi,
            '预测电量_GWh',
            f.energy_gwh
          ) ORDER BY f.duration_days DESC, f.opportunity_id
        ) FILTER(WHERE
          f.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL),
        CAST('[]' AS JSONB)
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM dynamic_stage_metric_map AS m
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    USING (stage_code)
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence AS f
    ON f.stage_code = m.stage_code AND f.band_code = m.band_code
  GROUP BY
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    m.stage_code,
    m.band_code,
    b.stage_name
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM dynamic_stage_results
  WHERE
    code = 'R16'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  r.status AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

OR17.name: 方案推动阶段严重超期商机数及预测量
OR17.definition: P2（new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate）完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的阶段中，超静态基线比例>=50%的商机数与期间预测。本阶段静态基线为7.2天，同一阶段统一使用，不随所选期间或样本变化。
OR17.rule: 以本阶段结束时间归期，开始可跨年；使用P2固定基线7.2天，逐笔计算(实际天数－静态基线)÷静态基线。只计完整已结束且严格正周期，0天、缺值、逆序及未结束不参与。OR12/OR14/OR16为0<超基线比例<50%并列展示，OR13/OR15/OR17为超基线比例>=50%触发原风险；同一阶段统一使用该静态基线。不同阶段可重复命中，跨阶段合计须区分阶段累加和商机去重。结束还须早于观察日次日，缺预测不排除周期样本，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。 展示档位为“严重超期”。
OR17.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), dynamic_stage_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), CAST('商机获取' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), CAST('技术交流' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), CAST('方案推动' AS TEXT))) AS v(stage_code, stage_name)
), dynamic_stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    b.stage_code,
    b.stage_name,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NULL
      THEN '缺阶段开始时间；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at < v.started_at
      THEN '日期逆序；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at = v.started_at THEN '零周期；不参与周期及分档'
      ELSE '所选期间已结束；使用严格大于0的完整实际周期'
    END AS timing_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    ON b.stage_code = v.stage_code
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1
    AND v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), dynamic_stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,stage_name,product_type,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS actual_mean_days,
    COUNT(duration_days)::bigint AS baseline_samples
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts
  GROUP BY stage_code,stage_name,product_type
), dynamic_stage_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    f.*,
    m.baseline_days,
    m.baseline_samples,
    (duration_days-baseline_days) AS excess_days,
  (duration_days-baseline_days)/NULLIF(baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN baseline_days IS NULL OR baseline_days <= 0 OR duration_days IS NULL
      THEN CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days > baseline_days
      AND duration_days < baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days >= baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days IS NOT NULL
      THEN CAST('NOT_OVERDUE' AS TEXT)
      ELSE CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
    END AS band_code
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts AS f
  JOIN dynamic_stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, stage_name, product_type)
), dynamic_stage_evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    ofc.forecast_rows,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    ofc.missing_amount_rows,
    ofc.missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS f
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
), dynamic_stage_metric_map AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (
      80,
      CAST('R12' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      81,
      CAST('R13' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      82,
      CAST('R14' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      83,
      CAST('R15' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      84,
      CAST('R16' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      85,
      CAST('R17' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    )) AS v(sort_no, code, metric_name, stage_code, band_code)
), severe_stage_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(h.stage_record_count),0)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.opportunity_id IS NULL) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stage_code) FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50') AS hit_stage_count
  FROM (
    SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*)::bigint AS stage_record_count
    FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50'
    GROUP BY opportunity_id
  ) h
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast f USING(opportunity_id)
), severe_stage_by_stage AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.stage_code,d.stage_name,
    CASE d.stage_code WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(f.forecast_rows,0)=0) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_definitions d
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence f ON f.stage_code=d.stage_code AND f.band_code='GE50'
  GROUP BY d.stage_code,d.stage_name
), dynamic_stage_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(SUM(f.amount_yi) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.opportunity_id) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(f.opportunity_id) > 0
      THEN '已输出命中数量；预测完整性见明细'
      WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.band_code IS NULL
      )
      THEN '未命中；部分时间不足或静态基线不可用，不能判为全部正常'
      ELSE '所选期间无命中商机'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('阶段静态基线：P0=32.6天、P1=21.8天、P2=7.2天、P3=57.2天、P4=15.3天，同阶段各产品共用基线；结束归期且仅周期>0参与分档。比例=(实际天数-静态基线)/静态基线；预测先聚合到商机，不影响周期样本。 LT50展示为超期，GE50展示为严重超期。严重超期跨阶段总览先按商机ID去重，再关联期间预测汇总金额及电量；阶段记录数和去重商机数分别列示，分阶段金额不可直接相加作为去重总金额。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '阶段',
      b.stage_name,
      '档位', m.band_code,
      '档位名称', CASE m.band_code WHEN 'LT50' THEN '超期' WHEN 'GE50' THEN '严重超期' END,
      '严重超期汇总_跨阶段去重', (SELECT TO_JSONB(s) FROM severe_stage_summary s),
      '严重超期分阶段汇总', (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(s) ORDER BY s.stage_code) FROM severe_stage_by_stage s),
      '各产品静态基线及有效正周期样本数',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('产品类型', d.product_type, '静态基线天', d.baseline_days, '有效正周期样本数', d.baseline_samples) ORDER BY d.product_type
          )
        FROM dynamic_stage_means AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '期间阶段记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '阶段日期不足记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.duration_days IS NULL
      ),
      '静态基线缺失或非正记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
          AND (
            d.baseline_days IS NULL OR d.baseline_days <= 0
          )
      ),
      '命中商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id),
      '有期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) > 0),
      '无期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) = 0),
      '命中商机金额不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.amount_yi IS NULL),
      '命中商机电量不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.energy_gwh IS NULL),
      '预测金额为空记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows), 0),
      '预测电量输入缺失记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows), 0),
      '预测合计说明',
      'SUM忽略单个NULL；缺失统计非零时金额或电量可能是部分合计；全部缺失保留NULL，不补0。',
      '商机明细',
      COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            '商机ID',
            f.opportunity_id,
            '产品',
            f.product_type,
            '截至日阶段推断',
            f.process_stage,
            '阶段开始',
            f.started_at,
            '阶段结束',
            f.finished_at,
            '计时状态',
            f.timing_status,
            '实际天数',
            f.duration_days,
            '基线天数', f.baseline_days,
            '超出基线天数', f.excess_days,
            '有效正周期样本数',
            f.baseline_samples,
            '超基线比例_原始小数',
            f.excess_ratio,
            '超基线百分比数值',
            f.excess_ratio * 100,
            '预测金额_亿元',
            f.amount_yi,
            '预测电量_GWh',
            f.energy_gwh
          ) ORDER BY f.duration_days DESC, f.opportunity_id
        ) FILTER(WHERE
          f.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL),
        CAST('[]' AS JSONB)
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM dynamic_stage_metric_map AS m
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    USING (stage_code)
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence AS f
    ON f.stage_code = m.stage_code AND f.band_code = m.band_code
  GROUP BY
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    m.stage_code,
    m.band_code,
    b.stage_name
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM dynamic_stage_results
  WHERE
    code = 'R17'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  r.status AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

IS12.name: 客户预测不足
IS12.description: 客户全部年度目标与总覆盖预测（进度＋剩余预测）先按客户ID汇总后比较；按各口径正缺口客户集合判断，战略重点储备与战略无商机情况用于原因定位。
IS12.condition: 仅按OR08明细中唯一的“风险专用正缺口汇总”判断：金额口径或电量口径的正缺口客户数>0即成立。先按客户ID汇总同一客户全部年度目标、进度和剩余预测，再分别计算金额缺口和电量缺口；各口径仅筛客户汇总缺口>0的客户集合，客户数按客户ID去重。目标、进度、剩余预测、总覆盖预测和缺口必须读取各口径同一正缺口客户集合的SQL汇总；同一客户的全部目标和预测先合并，不拆分后先筛子集，也不用其他客户的负缺口抵销正缺口。不得按明细数组长度判定。1117·R04有未签商机或1117·R09有无商机客户仅为原因事实，不能单独OR触发客户目标不足。必要输入缺失按缺失说明处理，不把未知补成0。
IS12.levelRule: 沿用客户目标缺口分级：已核实存在战略客户正缺口时为高，其他已核实客户正缺口为中。缺客户等级或必要输入时等级待核实；不因1117·R09名单有无商机客户而自动判高。示例“高”不写死。
IS12.source: 同步自亿纬锂能本体文件_1117 · RK06 客户预测不足

IS13.name: 商机推进超期，影响签单
IS13.description: 三个阶段P0/P1/P2已结束的有效正周期逐笔与各阶段固定基线比较，展示超期与严重超期两档；P0仍未结束的在途严重超期另作根因输入，不混入已结束平均、分档或合计。
IS13.condition: OR13、OR15、OR17任一已结束严重超期商机数>0即成立。普通超期并列展示，第三版仅删除“列为关注”措辞，未新增普通超期独立成立门槛。1117·P0-09在途数据仅作原因取数，不单独新增风险门槛。已结束样本须阶段结束落业务期间且早于观察日次日、起止完整且周期>0；开始可早于期初。静态基线P0=32.6、P1=21.8、P2=7.2、P3=57.2、P4=15.3天，同一阶段统一使用上述固定基线。
IS13.levelRule: 沿用已结束严重超期分级：命中覆盖至少2个阶段为高；不足2个阶段时，仅用跨阶段按商机ID去重且金额输入完整的影响预测金额分档，≥10亿元为高、<10亿元为中；金额缺失或仅部分合计、无法完成分档时等级待核实。P0在途量不混入上述已结束合计或金额分级。
IS13.source: 同步自亿纬锂能本体文件_1117 · RK11 商机推进超期，影响签单

DQ01.name: 指标取数失败或超时
DQ01.description: 调用SQL执行失败、超时或结果被截断，对应指标无法使用
DQ01.condition: 任一调用SQL状态为失败、超时或截断（查询目录 status ≠ ok）
DQ01.levelRule: 核心指标（B01～B04）取数失败 高；其他指标 中

DQ02.name: 核心指标结果为空
DQ02.description: 取数成功但目标或实绩为空，无法计算达成与缺口
DQ02.condition: B01～B04 任一调用SQL状态为 ok 且结果为 NULL

DQ03.name: 达成率与基础指标不一致
DQ03.description: 看板达成率与实绩 ÷ 目标的复算结果不一致，口径存疑
DQ03.source: 共同分析新增（口径复核）

DQ04.name: 订未发结构不闭合
DQ04.description: 超期与正常订未发金额之和与未发货金额不一致
DQ04.source: 共同分析新增（口径复核）

DQ05.name: 计划外发货无法核对
DQ05.description: 有已发货金额，但计划外发货因计划缺失或匹配不唯一返回空值
DQ05.condition: S02 > 0 且 S09 为 NULL
DQ05.source: 看板 M0151 空值口径

RC01.name: 上游商机预测覆盖不足
RC01.condition: OR01 商机预测缺口（金额或电量）> 0（商机获取本体 1117 R01 口径：缺口＝年度目标－（进度＋预测））
RC01.aiFocus: 引用商机获取本体 1117 RK01 口径：缺口＝年度目标－（进度＋预测），金额、电量分别判断；归纳缺口集中的产品类型
RC01.output: 是否成立、金额与电量缺口及缺口率

RC02.name: 签单转化滞后
RC02.condition: OR13、OR15、OR17 任一已结束严重超期商机数 > 0（商机获取本体 1117 BR-A11 口径，固定基线 1.5 倍）
RC02.aiFocus: 商机推进阶段严重超期拖慢签单：引用商机获取、技术交流、方案推动三个阶段的严重超期商机数与跨阶段去重预测金额
RC02.output: 是否成立、严重超期阶段、商机数与去重预测金额

RC03.name: 超期订单未发（交付执行卡点）
RC03.condition: S05 > 0 且 S12 存在超期天数 > 0 的订单
RC03.aiFocus: AI 读取超期订单对应商机的最新项目进展卡点与下一步（YWLN_D_PROJECT_BLOCKER / NEXT_STEP），归纳客户侧 / 内部原因
RC03.output: 超期订单清单（订单号、客户、金额、超期天数）、卡点归类、证据

RC04.name: 发货周期超标杆
RC04.aiFocus: 按产品团队定位周期最长环节
RC04.output: 是否成立、平均周期与标杆差值

RC05.name: 计划外发货扰动
RC05.aiFocus: 区分计划缺失、计划后改与超计划发货三类来源，说明对销售额与出货量节奏的影响
RC05.output: 是否成立、计划外金额、涉及订单行

RC06.name: 产品结构或单价偏离目标
RC06.aiFocus: AI 按产品类型（D003）比较订单电量与金额结构，判断是产品结构变化还是价格变化导致量价背离
RC06.output: 是否成立、实际与目标单位电量销售额、偏离方向与主要产品类型

RC08.name: 发货办理逾期
RC08.condition: S13 中“逾期未完成”或“逾期完成”电量 > 0
RC08.aiFocus: 按产品团队与客户定位逾期办理订单
RC08.output: 是否成立、逾期电量、涉及订单

RC09.name: 客户需求变化（取消／变更）
RC09.aiFocus: AI 读取 D016 订单状态分组与订单备注，区分客户取消、数量变更与交期变更
RC09.output: 取消 / 变更订单清单、涉及电量与金额、变更类型

RC10.name: 取数链路异常
RC10.condition: DQ01 成立的查询中存在连接失败、超时或截断错误码
RC10.aiFocus: 按错误码区分连接、权限、超时与行数上限；给出受影响指标清单
RC10.output: 失败查询清单（指标、错误码、耗时）

RC11.name: 源数据未维护或缺失
RC11.condition: DQ02 或 DQ05 成立（结果为空）
RC11.aiFocus: AI 定位缺失的源字段（目标、日出货计划、客户目标）与维护部门；证据不足时标注待核实
RC11.output: 缺失字段、涉及对象与维护责任方

RC12.name: 指标口径不一致
RC12.condition: DQ03 或 DQ04 成立（复算或结构不闭合）
RC12.aiFocus: 列出不一致的指标对、两侧数值与差额，说明可能的口径差异（期间、去重、取消订单处理）
RC12.output: 不一致指标对、差额与口径说明

RC13.name: 战略客户需求确认未落实
RC13.condition:
存在战略客户（等级 1）处于 截至阶段P0（由阶段结束时间链推断）、有效（statecode = 0）且未签单的商机，数量或预测金额 / 电量 > 0（客户口径：1117·C01 不再以需求未确认作取值过滤，需求确认情况作原因下钻）
已签/未签统一执行BR-Q09：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。 客户及商机须在观察截止前创建；等级和状态仍当前；AI结论仍待核实。
RC13.aiFocus: AI 对 1117·C01 商机下钻需求输入完成标志（new_demandinput）、客户需求提交 / 审批时间与项目进展文本，归纳未落实环节（需求未输入 / 未审批 / 被驳回）及客户侧原因；输出受影响商机清单与预测量 与其他风险共享保留；不再作为已删除签单风险的独立根因，不替代RC19的商机储备分析。
RC13.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC14.name: 其余商机需求未确认
RC14.condition:
1117·C09 其余占比 ≥ 30%，且 1117·C06（重点跟踪以外、P0、statecode = 0、未签单、new_demandinput = 0）商机数或预测金额 / 电量 > 0；金额、电量分别判断
已签/未签统一执行BR-Q09：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。 预测、目标及关联实体均使用同一观察截至；原结构比例阈值、归因参考关系及AI待核实属性保持。
RC14.aiFocus: AI 对其余未签单商机按需求输入标志与进展文本分组，列出需优先确认的商机
RC14.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC15.name: 商机获取环节卡点
RC15.condition: P0 阶段超期（1117·P0-02 > 0）时，按小环节自身起止定位：1117·P0-03 签保密协议、1117·P0-04 输入客户需求、1117·P0-05 选择协作团队、1117·P0-06 申请需求输入、1117·P0-07 创建或更新销售预测、1117·P0-08 确认客户组织架构；单笔周期 > 总体同环节动态均值 × 1.5；由 IS13 进入时以 OR13 > 0 为前提，对 OR13 清单商机定位卡点环节 环节动态均值取总体同环节已结束有效样本，不设分类基线；阶段判定仍使用固定阶段基线。
RC15.aiFocus: AI 依据可得事件（保密协议起止、客户需求提交 / 审批、销售预测完成）与进展文本定位卡点环节 阶段定位须同时输出实际周期、对应静态基线、超出基线天数与比例；无法从事件或文本核实的卡点不作确定原因。 在IS13下仅作小环节待核实定位；不重复RC20的P0已结束/在途总数，也不再次生成“P0大量超期”的同义根因。无事件证据时保留待核实说明，不仅凭超期统计认定系统性效率或具体业务卡点。
RC15.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC16.name: 战略客户尚未建立商机储备
RC16.condition: 引用1117·R09客户底表、储能范围及截至日无任何关联商机名单。无商机是事实，不等同无拜访、未开拓；逐户读取SQL返回的客户年度目标金额、电量、目标版本数及缺失单元格数，核实是否与IS12正缺口客户集合关联。未配对目标时不直接量化该客户缺口。
RC16.aiFocus: 说明截至日仍无商机的战略客户数量，并逐户列目标与缺失情况，定位目标缺少商机承接的部分。1117·R09名单数与IS12缺口客户数为不同集合，不能直接相等或相加；不把示例79写死。客户开发、响应或需求未识别须有线索/拜访/需求记录支持，缺证据只作待核实。
RC16.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC17.name: 技术交流环节卡点
RC17.condition: 技术交流阶段存在超静态基线 50% 及以上的已结束商机（OR15 > 0）时，按小环节自身起止定位：1117·P1-03 客户准入、1117·P1-04 是否需立项、1117·P1-05 送样评审、1117·P1-06 报价管理、1117·P1-07 申请报价；单笔周期 > 总体同环节动态均值 × 1.5 环节动态均值取总体同环节已结束有效样本，不设分类基线；阶段判定仍使用固定阶段基线。
RC17.aiFocus: AI 依据客户准入、立项评估、送样测试、报价申请等事件时间与项目进展文本，定位 OR15 清单商机卡在哪个环节，并给出各环节滞留天数分布；缺环节完成事件时只作文本判断 阶段定位须同时输出实际周期、对应静态基线、超出基线天数与比例；无法从事件或文本核实的卡点不作确定原因。 在IS13下仅作小环节待核实定位；不重复RC20的P0已结束/在途总数，也不再次生成“P0大量超期”的同义根因。无事件证据时保留待核实说明，不仅凭超期统计认定系统性效率或具体业务卡点。
RC17.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC18.name: 方案推动超期涉及金额较大
RC18.condition: IS13成立且OR17已结束P2严重超期有命中时，读取单阶段商机数、金额/电量、实际周期和超出P2静态基线7.2天的天数与比例。是否涉及金额居三个阶段首位，必须比较OR13/OR15/OR17同一范围的阶段量值后才表述，不写死排名或金额；无完整金额时注明部分合计/无法比较。
RC18.aiFocus: 阶段固定基线为7.2天，实际平均周期从1117·P2-01总体主值独立读取，不把7.2当成数据库实测均值。根因先说明已结束阶段超期和影响预测，再结合技术协议/规格书、质保或资信审批事件核实具体卡点；没有事件支撑不宣称审批已构成原因。
RC18.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC19.name: 战略及重点客户商机储备不足
RC19.condition: 读取1117·C10金额口径和电量口径：战略等级1、重点等级2的商机储备必须与OR08各口径按客户ID汇总后筛出的正缺口客户集合及预测窗口一致，集合内每一客户的全部商机预测均按相同窗口纳入。已签预测、未签剩余预测、总覆盖预测、未签商机数和占比全部引用SQL给出的值。仅当数据完整且值确为0时才表述已签预测为0；不能从未签商机集合推导已签金额为0，不能把已签商机预测称实际订单金额。
RC19.aiFocus: 按第三版将本根因聚焦商机储备，不强行拼接推进缓慢：说明同范围战略重点客户在覆盖集合内的已签商机预测、未签商机剩余预测、总覆盖预测、未签商机数量及占同范围客户总覆盖预测比例。1117·C10覆盖集合内已签包括当前及未来月份的已签记录，不等同OR08只取已历月份的进度，更不是实际订单金额。未签存量数与有覆盖预测未签数分开引用。比例只作结构定位，结合OR08目标正缺口说明承接情况；缺分母或输入时标无法核实，不写固定54、0、8.42%等示例。当前阶段停留如需下钻可查看原1117·R04明细，但不作为本根因强制描述，也不把一般客户套成战略重点客户。
RC19.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

RC20.name: 商机获取阶段滞留较多
RC20.condition: IS13已成立，且（OR13已结束P0严重超期数>0，或1117·P0-09在途严重超期数>0）时，分别引用两组P0事实。已结束用new_stage1enddate－createdon，在途用观察日全天结束－createdon；均按32.6天固定基线，严重超期≥48.9天。两组样本互斥、分开列示，在途不参与1117·P0-01平均或已结束OR13及三阶段合计。1117·P0-02严格>48.9天只作历史兼容诊断，不与OR13相加，也不作为该根因唯一进入条件。
RC20.aiFocus: 以同一个P0原因段同时说明“已结束P0严重超期”及“当前P0在途严重超期”两组数量、可用预测金额/电量、超过32.6天基线的天数和比例。基线与实际平均值明确分开；不得把已结束记录说成当前仍在P0，也不得将两组数量当成平均样本数。在途需日期链一致，前序缺失/逆序等异常只列无法核实，不得形成长时间滞留结论。数量是否居各阶段首位须由返回值核对；具体卡点待客户响应、需求确认等事件支持。
RC20.output: 原因摘要默认展开；引用的指标和明细证据先放在根因后，后续再按页面安排去除证据入口；内部取数及来源保留用于核实。

AC01.name: 联动补足商机预测覆盖
AC01.action: 联动补足商机预测覆盖
AC01.measure: 按商机获取本体 1117 RK01 口径（OR01）的缺口对象，逐产品类型补齐商机与月度预测，缺口无法补足的给出目标调整建议
AC01.object: 商机预测缺口集中的产品团队与客户

BR-Q01.name: 销售额实绩口径

BR-Q02.name: 出货量实绩口径

BR-Q03.name: 目标去重口径
BR-Q03.description: 销售目标先按 COALESCE(商机 ID, 目标 ID)＋年度按 createdon DESC、new_targetid DESC 取 rn = 1，再展开 12 个月汇总；金额 ÷ 10^8，电量 new_month*_power 按 kWh ÷ 10^6（同商机获取节点 BR-Q03 / BR-Q11）
BR-Q03.result: 客户、产品、团队仅为汇总维度，不作去重键

BR-Q04.name: 有效订单口径
BR-Q04.description: 订单按 OA 审批时间归期；有效订单行沿用看板 M0032 口径；订单状态分正常订单 / 订单变更 / 订单取消（D016）
BR-Q04.result: 取消订单在履约率分子分母两侧同时排除

BR-Q05.name: 订未发与超期判定
BR-Q05.description: 承诺发货日 = 订单产品 requestdeliveryby（同一订单多行取最早）；早于统计截止日仍未发货为超期订未发，否则为正常订未发
BR-Q05.result: 金额字段缺失或来源有歧义时返回空值，不补 0

BR-Q06.name: 时间进度口径
BR-Q06.description: 年度时间消耗 = 统计截止日已过天数 ÷ 全年天数
BR-Q06.result: 统计截止日为所选期末与观察日较早者

BR-Q07.name: 共同分析同期间约束
BR-Q07.description: 跨环节（商机 / 订单 / 发货）证据必须同一统计期间、同一默认筛选范围；至少两个环节有证据才输出共同分析
BR-Q07.result: 期间不一致的证据不合并；缺失环节在结果中披露

BR-Q08.name: 跨环节不混算
BR-Q08.description: 不同业务状态（预测 / 订单 / 发货）只做关联比较，不相加为同一指标
BR-Q08.result: 跨环节比较须注明各自口径与观察时间

BR-Q09.name: 签单判定
BR-Q09.description: 截至日签单按二态判断：商机经订单明细new_opportunity_id→salesorderid关联真实订单头，且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日时为已签（TRUE）；无关联订单、P3结束为空或P3结束不早于观察日次日，均为未签（FALSE）。
BR-Q09.result: 本体截至日签单仅设观察日次日上限，不加本期期初下限；只有专门统计本期新增签单时才另加start_date下限。签单判定不使用订单OA审批日期、订单createdon或合同确认枚举。已有订单但P3结束为空统一按未签，不单列其他签单状态。订单取消/审批枚举仍不额外加入该签单规则；普通订单评审/交付周期本身使用的OA事件不属于签单过滤。
BR-Q09.action: 输出截至日已签、未签及相应计数；未签指标筛signed IS FALSE，无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均纳入未签。

BR-Q10.name: 阶段实际平均周期与静态超期基线
BR-Q10.description: P0＝createdon→new_stage1enddate；P1～P4＝相邻阶段结束日期配对。已结束周期按本阶段真实结束时间归业务期间且早于观察日次日，只计完整严格正周期；起点可早于期初，不按当前阶段枚举排除历史已结束阶段。实际均值由有效明细直接AVG；阶段判定固定采用P0=32.6、P1=21.8、P2=7.2、P3=57.2、P4=15.3天，同一阶段统一使用上述基线。1117·P0-09另取截至日仍P0的在途存量，用观察日结束减创建时间，不设本期新建下限，日期链异常不判档；在途不进入已结束AVG与分档。
BR-Q10.result: 已结束OR12/OR14/OR16为基线<周期<1.5倍；OR13/OR15/OR17为周期>=1.5倍。1117·P0-09在途按相同P0固定基线分两档；在途严重超期只作根因取数，不新增独立风险门槛。P*-02/1117·C07保留严格>1.5倍的历史兼容边界，不与>=类相加。

BR-Q11.name: 严重超期数量及影响金额
BR-Q11.description: 已结束严重超期摘要同时给阶段记录数、跨阶段去重商机数、去重预测金额/电量，分阶段另列两档及各自预测。跨阶段金额先按商机去重，不能直接加OR13/OR15/OR17。1117·P0-09在途数量和量值另列在根因，不加入已结束358类示例合计；不固定写示例数量金额。缺输入显示部分或无法核实。 第三版截图5指向周期风险7摘要整块：名称更新为“商机推进超期，影响签单”，同时显示已结束严重超期数量及对应金额、电量；分阶段超期/严重超期行同步使用新名称。截图示意与生成内容按同一指标取值，不固定照抄旧358等数字。
BR-Q11.result: 按本规则约束输出，不额外计算风险阈值
BR-Q11.action: 由读取本体的生成端或页面落实；本文件修订不等同已修改在线页面。
